messages:
maya: Quick preflight — starting canary for release v2.4.1 in 10m. Deploy bot will kick in at 2026-03-21T14:00Z. Ops: if p50 latency > 200ms for >2m OR 5% error rate -> backout. Links: release notes: https://redwood/internal/releases/v2.4.1 runbook: https://runbooks.internal/deploy/evacuation rollback: https://runbooks.internal/deploy/rollback. Pin fallback: commit abcdef123. @ops-oncall @samir please ack and monitor.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary cb-4456: v2.4.1 -> 10% traffic eu-west-1 at 2026-03-21T14:00Z. Metrics: https://dd.internal/dashboards/cb-4456. To abort: `/deploybot abort cb-4456` (must be run by release-approver or oncall).

leo: ack. Watching latency and error dashboards. I'll have a quick smoke check at +2m.

samir: noted. I pushed a quick canary watch job: `scripts/canary_watch.sh cb-4456` — will alert in #eng-oncall if error rate spikes.

ops-oncall: Got it. I have the rollback runbook open. Criteria I use to trigger backout (TL;DR):
- 5 consecutive minutes of >5% 5xxs OR
- sustained p50 > 300ms for 3m OR
- user-facing regression reported by SRE or product QA.
If triggered, I'll pin to abcdef123 and run `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=12` then clear caches.

maya: If you back out, please also revert the model-weights config change from ops-configs (PR #227). That's the one that caused flaky latencies in staging.

samir: FYI the canary includes a database migration toggle — it's behind a feature flag but double-checking DB connections is good. If we backout, take the feature-flag off as part of the rollback checklist.

leo: Quick note: release notes updated with migration steps and rollback checklist: https://redwood/internal/releases/v2.4.1#rollback

ops-oncall: Canary live +2m. Initial metrics look fine. p50=120ms, error rate=0.8% :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% traffic successfully at 2026-03-21T14:02Z. cb-4456 -> state=healthy

maya: Doing smoke test now — running `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}" https://api.redwood/test` — will post results.

leo: smoke looks clean from eu-west-1. 200s and ~0.15s latency.

samir: small spike at 14:07Z to 2.1% errors for 30s, traced to a retry loop in worker. I pushed hotfix candidate (diff 1234) but we should not hotpatch during canary. Ops, decide?

ops-oncall: I want to watch 2 more minutes. If error rate grows to >3% and persists 2m, I'll abort. For now leave canary.

maya: agreed — no hotpatch until decision.

ops-oncall: 14:10Z — error rate back down to 0.9%. p50 steady. Holding.

samir: good, I'm rolling the fix into main but will hold deploy.

leo: If we do need to abort, reminder steps:
1) `/deploybot abort cb-4456` -> will stop traffic and kick rollback.
2) pin service to abcdef123 (ops-configs revert)
3) run `kubectl rollout undo` for api and workers
4) disable migration flag
5) open postmortem draft in #postmortems

ops-oncall: 14:12Z — decision: safe to continue rollout to 50% in 10m. I'll escalate if any regression. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks everyone. I'll leave this thread open — will post final status after full rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary cb-4456 increasing to 50% at 2026-03-21T14:22Z as requested by ops-oncall.

ops-oncall: 14:22Z — 50% rollout started. No further flags.

samir: monitoring logs for the hotfix integration. No errors so far.

maya: 15:00Z — rollout to 100% complete, all checks green. Closing the loop.

ops-oncall: closing thread — filed short postmortem note: https://redwood/internal/postmortems/pm-4456
